sections.title: Teeth of Adult Aotus nancymaae
paragraphs: The teeth of Aotus reflect their frugivorous (fruit-eating) diet. They have broad incisors and relatively small canines compared to other primates. Like all platyrrhines, they have three premolars, and their dental formula is 2-1-3-3/2-1-3-3.
sections.caption: Teeth of adult Aotus nancymaae (DWA-Aotus1).

sections.title: Newborn Aotus Dentition
paragraphs: At birth, the deciduous dentition (baby teeth) are just beginning to erupt.
sections.caption: Teeth of newborn Aotus nancymaae (Aotus108).
